evidence: Carries the Mempool label and fixes incorrect eviction of valid BIP68 transactions and their descendants from the mempool during reorg processing in MaybeUpdateMempoolForReorg.
rationale: Fixes an issue where valid transactions spending unconfirmed inputs are incorrectly dropped from the mempool during reorgs. As demonstrated in #35007, stale cached lockpoints evaluated against the disconnected tip caused removeForReorg to treat sequence locks as unsatisfied and evict transactions prematurely rather than recalculating them at the new tip.
